1.2.3.8-f14.accuracy_reason: Sallust, Catiline 10.1, reads 'Carthago aemula imperi Romani ab stirpe interiit'. The two changes the note describes are real.

1.2.3.8-f6.accuracy_reason: Juvenal, Satires 3.182–3, reads 'hic vivimus ambitiosa / paupertate omnes'. Burton does replace 'vivimus' with 'laboramus'.
